taste: the deep comedy of Tim Heidecker, Marc Maron, Louis C.K. and Bill Burr, with no interest in raunch for its own sake
note: Hand-kept. Claude rated these names from general knowledge, with a Wikipedia cross-check for notability. The reasons are not verified against sources. A comedian can have one rating, both, or none. No rating means not rated; it is not a negative rating.
how_to_rate_profile: star = big name, known = known comedian, rising = rising star.
how_to_rate_taste: Read the taste above as: dark, personal or confessional material, long rants with a strong point of view, or deadpan absurdism. strong = close to that; partial = shares some of it; different = another style (clean, light, raunchy, crowd work, act-outs). 'different' is about style, not quality. Raunch: these readers are not into raunchy comedy, and not put off by it. So filth or shock never raises a rating. An act that is mostly sex or shock material is 'different', or 'partial' when it also has real depth. A deep comedian who is sometimes dirty keeps the rating.
